name: Probability
description: Sample spaces, random variables, conditioning, limit theorems — the language every other topic is written in.

name: Statistics
description: Estimation, inference, hypothesis testing and the sampling error that makes backtests lie.

name: Linear Algebra
description: Vector spaces, decompositions and eigenstructure — covariance matrices, PCA and risk models all live here.

name: Calculus
description: Differentiation, integration, Taylor expansion and multivariate analysis, including the Greeks.

name: Optimization
description: Convexity, Lagrangians, KKT conditions and numerical solvers behind every portfolio allocation.

name: Numerical Methods
description: Finite differences, quadrature, root finding, linear solvers and floating-point pitfalls.

name: Stochastic Processes
description: Random walks, Markov chains, martingales, Brownian motion and Itô calculus.

name: Time Series
description: Stationarity, ARMA, GARCH, cointegration and forecasting financial data that refuses to be i.i.d.

name: Econometrics
description: Regression under real-world violations: endogeneity, heteroskedasticity, panel data, causal inference.

name: Statistical Learning
description: Bias–variance, regularisation, cross-validation, trees and neural nets applied to low signal-to-noise data.

name: Quantitative Trading
description: Strategy archetypes, edge, capacity, turnover and the economics of a trading business.

name: Alpha Research
description: Signal construction, feature engineering, orthogonalisation and honest evaluation of predictive power.

name: Factor Models
description: CAPM, Fama–French, statistical factors, risk decomposition and factor crowding.

name: Portfolio Construction
description: Mean–variance, Black–Litterman, risk parity, constraints, transaction costs and Kelly sizing.

name: Risk Management
description: VaR, expected shortfall, stress testing, drawdown control and the limits of historical risk.

name: Backtesting
description: Point-in-time data, look-ahead bias, multiple testing, deflated Sharpe and walk-forward validation.

name: Alternative Data
description: Satellite, card, web and text data: sourcing, cleaning, entity mapping, decay and legal constraints.

name: Derivatives
description: Forwards, futures, swaps, replication, no-arbitrage pricing and risk-neutral valuation.

name: Options
description: Black–Scholes, the Greeks, implied volatility surfaces, exotics and volatility trading.

name: Fixed Income
description: Yield curves, duration, convexity, bootstrapping, credit spreads and rates models.

name: Market Microstructure
description: Order books, spreads, adverse selection, price impact, market making and queue position.

name: Execution
description: Implementation shortfall, VWAP/TWAP, optimal scheduling, slippage and transaction cost analysis.

name: Programming & Algorithms
description: Data structures, complexity, vectorised numerics, testing and research code that survives contact with production.

name: Mental Math & Brainteasers
description: Fast arithmetic, estimation, expected-value puzzles and the classic trading-floor brainteasers.
